sn7.14:1.2: atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇamahāsālo lūkho lūkhapāpuraṇo 2 yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn7.14:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn7.14:1.5: idha me bho gotama cattāro puttā
sn7.14:1.6: te maṃ dārehi saṃpuccha gharā nikkhāmentīti.
sn7.14:1.7: tenahi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa imā gāthāyo pariyāpuṇitvā sabhāyaṃ mahājanakāye sannipatite puttesu ca sannisinnesu bhāsassu
sn7.14:7.1: atha kho so brāhmaṇamahāsālo bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo pariyāpuṇitvā sabhāyaṃ mahājanakāye sannipatite puttesu ca sannisinnesu abhāsi
sn7.14:13.1: atha kho naṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālaṃ puttā gharaṃ netvā nhāpetvā paccekaṃ dussayugena acchādesuṃ.
sn7.14:13.2: atha kho so brāhmaṇamahāsālo ekaṃ dussayugaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn7.14:13.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇamahāsālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn7.14:13.4: mayaṃ bho gotama brāhmaṇā nāma ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesāma
sn7.14:13.5: paṭiggaṇhātu me bhavaṃ gotamo ācariyo ācariyabhāganti.
sn7.14:13.7: atha kho so brāhmaṇamahāsālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn7.14:13.9: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
